caption: The drawing contains two main sections. In the upper section, there is an outlined depiction of a ceramic crock with small handles on each side. The crock is mostly white with black linework, and it has an oval-shaped label at the top center that reads "BROWN BROTHERS / HUNTINGTON" in small capital letters, with the number "11" below the label. Below the number, on the surface of the crock, is a small blue illustration of a plant with leaves and a cluster of berries. In the lower section, there is a larger, more detailed version of the same plant with blue leaves and a cluster of berries, all painted in shades of blue and set against a grayish rectangular background. Above this plant illustration is the number "1½" written in a serif font. The artist's signature appears in cursive at the lower left corner of the drawing. The overall composition is vertically aligned, with the outlined crock above the detailed plant illustration. The background of the drawing is a light, neutral tone.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
